Overview.Name: P.SKD Prasad
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results, avoids non-veg on Tuesday and Saturday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Chicken pan fried (120 g) + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & sautéed vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & curd
Meal_3 (Dinner - lighter): Option 3: Paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable fry

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid non-veg on Tuesday and Saturday and follow vegetarian options.
Field work and irregular timings can increase cravings, so avoid skipping meals.
Start meals with eggs, chicken or paneer before eating rice.
Limit late-night eating and outside spicy foods during social gatherings.
Morning sunlight exposure and consistent yoga will improve energy, recovery and body composition.
